prOriginal.nota: No upstream PR: the benchmark head 060cda77 (Régis Hanol, 'FIX: proper handling of group memberships') was committed directly to master on 2015-01-05 and is an ancestor of main (compare = ahead); /commits/<sha>/pulls is empty. The merged code is the benchmark head itself.

fix-proper-handling-of-group-memberships.reason: The Math.floor(user_count/limit)+1 totalPages moved unchanged from admin-group.js.es6 into components/group-members-input.js.es6 (7bfabb02, 2016-12-13). Commit 9090c7b0 'FIX: Admin groups editor was showing extra page when exactly 50 records' (2017-05-17) changed it to Math.ceil(userCount / limit).

The next/previous paging that set offset and called findMembers (which unconditionally setProperties from each response) survived unchanged, last in components/group-members-input rendered by admin/templates/group.hbs. No change ever added request cancellation or a staleness check; the admin group pages that rendered this paging were removed in c82b2dcc 'Remove admin group management pages' (2018-04-09), and the component itself was deleted as dead code in 352d43b1 (#8356, 2019-11-18), with findMembers rewritten to append-only load-more.

Commit 8fd69fd3 'FIX: group member pages only showing first 50 members alphabetically' (2015-02-19) added a group/members controller with a loadMore action and a LoadMore view mixin on the public group members page, so members beyond the first 50 page are fetched by infinite scroll.

Commit f7f5e39f 'FIX: Minor Admin bug with a setting when creating a new group' (2015-01-23) added group.alias_level = params[:alias_level].to_i if params[:alias_level].present? to Admin::GroupsController#create.

Commit e8323fa5 'FIX: removing a group from a user was not removing primary group' (2015-02-09) made remove_member load the user, set primary_group_id = nil when it equals the group id and save it, with a spec asserting primary_group_id becomes nil.

PR #3378 'FIX: show error message if user already exist in group' (merged 2015-04-15) wrapped group.add in if !group.users.include?(user) and returns a 422 member_already_exist error instead of hitting the unique index (spec 'returns 422 if member already exists'). Earlier users in the list could still be added before the 422; that residue went away later when GroupsController#add_members began checking all users first (group.users.where(id: users.pluck(:id))) before adding any.

astra.pergunta: Does #3378 (skip-check returning 422 for an existing member, partial add still possible) count as the fix, or should the later all-or-nothing pre-check be the fix date?
astra.resposta: confirmado by 499bed69/#3378 on 2015-04-15: it directly fixed adding an existing member (no unique-index violation, 422 instead of 500); the partial add is a residual problem fixed later and does not delay the classification.

fix-proper-handling-of-group-memberships.reason: GroupsController#members got a negative check in 982df3c1 'FIX: return status 400 for invalid member params' (2018-06-29: limit < 0 raises InvalidParameters) and an upper bound in 704c5795 'FIX: do not allow unbound membership lookups' (2019-06-17: limit > 1000 raises InvalidParameters). Main today uses fetch_limit_from_params(default:, max: MEMBERS_MAX_PAGE_SIZE). The fix date is when both halves were in place.
